COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoglycemia. There is evidence of systemic inflammation (elevated CRP, ferritin, and several leukocyte subpopulations), and a prolonged INR suggesting coagulopathy. Liver and renal function are preserved. Findings are consistent with acute systemic illness, possibly infection or inflammation, with hematologic involvement and risk of bleeding. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
